reviews.title: Looks pretty - Removed features.  No warning, no thanks!
reviews.text: I’ve had this since it was Lookout Life (Since 2012) and paid for and carried Premium for all this time.  14 years.  Then Kiren is forced upon us and guess what?  NO Identity Theft Protection.  It was silently removed while their description of the “upgrade” says it monitors the same things when you pay for “Plus” but there is zero identity theft included.  I’m OUT.  This went from a plain looking AAA protection (On iOS and Android) to AAA looking D-list protection.  This “Upgrade” has given me absolutely zero reasons to keep it.  I can move over to Nord, get the same stuff with an actual VPN AND $1M identity theft insurance. You know, the service silently discontinued.   What a slap in the face to long time customers. We shouldn’t care what the pretty interface looks like. In fact, if we’re in it, we’re looking into a breach or problem, otherwise there’s no reason to open it past the setup!  Form over function is not the best for a security app. Since you’re priorities are to make a pretty looking app without disclosing discontinued services, I can’t trust you.  How can I trust a security company with my data when they don’t even disclosed the removal of one major feature?  I can’t.  Literally went from “I’ve recommended this to everyone I know” to massive texts to the same people telling them the one feature that made this stand out was silently removed. What a shame.

reviews.title: Something rotten in Denmark…
reviews.text:
I’ve had the app on my phone for years and opened it today after much time. I see a four month free promotion for their “total plan” and sign up for it through my account link. I provide my info and it asks me to create an account. I click on “login” and suddenly, my phone no longer remembers the password. I close and reopen the app and I’m still logged in on the app but to the basic plan and doesn’t upgrade. I go back to the website, click on “forgot my password”and I’m still waiting after my third attempt. They have my credit card number so I decide I’m going to cancel. Guess what…yeah, it’s like that. Now I will likely have to endure, what I’m sure will be a lengthy time consuming process to get rid of this thing and implement safeguards so they don’t charge me. If it sounds too good to be true…better the devil you know, I guess.  
TO THE DEVELOPER; please don’t contact me telling me how sorry you are that I’m having these issues or going through this difficult experience, and to just contact your support team and they’ll be more than happy to guide me through it, because I did, three times, THREE times, and I’m still waiting. These are simple issues that shouldn’t be issues, because it’s a Mobile Security app and you should know better. You should know better!
